LanguageData.pas_warfare_SettingEnableFallTip: Master toggle. When enabled, a vassal settlement whose defense fails (per the thresholds below) truly changes hands: it leaves your empire and becomes a regular settlement of the attacking faction, registered into Rim War. When disabled, Empire's vanilla behavior applies (losses only, no conquest).
LanguageData.pas_warfare_SettingOnlyRimWar: Only Rim War units can conquer vassals
LanguageData.pas_warfare_SettingOnlyRimWarTip: When enabled, only attacks by Rim War warbands/scouts can lead to a fall; Empire's own random raid events still cause losses only.
LanguageData.pas_warfare_SettingCrushRatioTip: In an auto-resolved defeat, if the attacker's remaining force is at least this fraction of its initial force, the defeat counts as "crushing" and the settlement falls immediately. Lower = falls happen more easily. Losing a manual map battle (all defenders dead) always counts as crushing.
LanguageData.pas_warfare_SettingFailStreakTip: The same vassal also falls after this many consecutive failed defenses (crushing or not). 0 = disabled; only crushing defeats trigger falls. A successful defense resets the counter.
LanguageData.pas_warfare_SettingProtectionDaysTip: Days after a settlement is founded (or after this mod is added to a save) during which failed defenses never cause a fall. 0 = no protection.
LanguageData.pas_warfare_SettingHeatDecayTip: Rim War throttles attacks on vassals with a "vassal heat" gate: each attack raises the heat, so the same vassal gets targeted less and less often. A value > 0 decays that heat daily, making vassals more frequent targets; 0 = Rim War's native pacing.
LanguageData.pas_warfare_VassalFallenDesc: Our vassal settlement "{0}" has been overrun and now belongs to {1}.\n\nIt is now a regular enemy settlement, registered into the world war. Use the Empire military "Capture settlement" job to take it back.
LanguageData.pas_warfare_VassalProtectedMsg: {0} lost its defense, but is still within its grace period and was spared from falling.
LanguageData.pas_warfare_VassalRecapturedDesc: "{0}", once lost to {1}, has been retaken and is a vassal settlement of our empire again.
